text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—And so! As my birthday present, I command 
you to write a book about me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
WHAT MAKES YOU SAY THAAAAT!? Ah, no, I 
passionately want to celebrate 
Tachyon-san's birthday, but that's an 
entirely different matter—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haven't I told you before? Your powers of 
observation when it comes to Umamusume are 
maddeningly sharp—quite commendable, 
really.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A book that is the fruit of your 
observations... ...I am quite intrigued to 
see what it is like.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hieee...! I-I am deeply honored and 
humbled by your compliments! But as for 
the book, well, as I mentioned before...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I cannot show you as it goes against my 
policy," hmm? You're quite stubborn 
yourself. ...Very well, let's do this 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
From today onward, for a little while, 
keep all your eyes fixed upon me. Stay 
close, yet not too close, and observe me 
constantly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And then compile all the details into a 
report and give it to me as a present. 
Without paying any mind to the other 
Umamusume, of course.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
C-Constantly observing Tachyon-san and 
only her, neither too close nor too 
far...!? T-That's... That kind of thing is 
just...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Official observation permission?! That 
practically\nturns the celebration right 
back around onto me~~!?\nOf course! I will 
respond! With total sincerity!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, yes. I'll also be asking you to 
handle the mundane daily chores that 
accompany the observation. You don't mind 
that either, do you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Sir, yes, sir!! Yours truly, Agnes 
Digital!! I shall serve and observe 
Tachyon-san with all my heart and soul, 
and report back every single detail 
without holding back!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh. ...Yes, that look in your eyes is 
what I wanted. Now then, I look forward to 
a fine gift, Digital-kun.
